name: Snow
description:
Platinum Blonde

100% Brazilian Remy human hair in a beautiful platinum blonde with soft root

The platinum color gives her a clean, icy blonde look while the subtle variation throughout keeps the color from looking flat. The long layers and soft waves add movement and give her a full, polished finish.

Because this is 100% human hair, treat and style her just like your natural hair. She arrives professionally colored and styled, but shipping may affect the finished look, so you may want to restyle her to your preference after unboxing.
